title: Atlas contracts — common types (v1)
description: Shared catalogue vocabulary for the Atlas asset model. Catalogue concepts only: no integration-criticality, EOL risk, portfolio scoring or AI review (those work with the data and live in the private Atlas core). See handbook 11 §1.

AssetKind.description: The kind of asset held in the catalogue. The data-layer kinds (data-area, dataset, column) model the data architecture beneath a system, down to the column. The AI kinds (ai-service, ai-model) catalogue AI platforms and models as first-class assets.

Lifecycle.description: Catalogue lifecycle state. Held metadata, not analysis.

AssetId.description: Stable, opaque identifier for an asset. Never reused, never re-meaning'd once published.

Tag.description: Manual, lightweight classification. A key with an optional value.

ExternalId.description: An importer-supplied identifier from a source system, used to resolve references and to match on re-import. Opaque to Atlas; only unique within a single import bundle.

Ref.description: A reference to an asset within an import bundle — matching either an asset's 'id' or its 'externalId' present in the same bundle. Resolution is a bundle-level rule the conformance kit checks; JSON Schema only fixes the shape.

Generator.description: Provenance for an export: what produced the document. Held metadata, not analysis.

version.description: The producing tool's version, if known.

ServerDetails.description: Held server metadata. OS is a recorded fact, not an EOL/risk assessment (that is paid Atlas core).

DataAreaDetails.description: Held metadata for a data area (dataområde) — a logical grouping of datasets inside one system. Cataloguing only; 'realisation' is free metadata (e.g. microservice, reference-catalogue, spreadsheet), not a locked vocabulary and not analysis.

DatasetDetails.description: Held metadata for a dataset (datamodel) — one table / one dataset. Cataloguing only: physical name and ownership are recorded facts, never quality or classification verdicts (those work with the data and are paid Atlas core).

ColumnDetails.description: Held metadata for a column (kolonne) — a concrete field on a dataset. The declared data type and nullability are recorded facts. NO analysis: no quality score, no classification verdict, no PII/sensitivity flag (those are paid Atlas core, handbook 11 §1).

AiServiceDetails.description: Held AI service metadata. Cataloguing only: provider, endpoint and environment are recorded facts, never analysis.

AiModelDetails.description: Held AI model metadata. Cataloguing only: model name, version, provider and embedding dimensions are recorded facts, never analysis.
